summary: A swarm manager: many swarms, each one coordinator pursuing one goal, with the boxes the swarm draws for itself and the connections between them. A swarm is born with three nodes — a loop, a coordinator and a goal — and the loop turns until the goal is reached.

domains.name: swarm.agent
domains.summary: The members of a swarm: each a Role on a Host, spawned by the orchestrator, given one assignment at a time as an inbox post, reporting its own state through the event-log kinds, and retired.

domains.name: swarm.blackbox
domains.summary: The canvas: schemas known to everyone, boxes that show only inputs and outputs, and the connections agents make between them — each with a delivery guarantee and a failure policy, as an ESS binding has.

domains.name: swarm.manager
domains.summary: Many swarms, each created, started, paused, stopped and deleted here.

domains.name: swarm.mailbox
domains.summary: Named mailboxes per agent, messages addressed to a pair, read and acked as lifecycle states, and a broadcast that is N messages sharing one id.

domains.name: swarm.config
domains.summary: The runtime configuration a swarm runs with — paths, launch line, schedules, budgets, board defaults — drafted, activated one at a time, superseded.

domains.name: swarm.goal
domains.summary: One goal per swarm, pursued in a loop that stops when it is reached.
